title: Versions and updates
summary: Install a newer published update from the app, accept the detected running version, or record approval and backup evidence before installing an update.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Installed versions lists every version that has run, newest first, with its status; Running marks the current one. When the running version awaits acceptance, run the laboratory’s checks, choose Accept this version for clinical use in its row menu or details and enter a note with fresh identity confirmation. You do not type a version, select a package or choose a backup for this acceptance.

Available updates opens first. It starts with a status box: This app is up to date, An update is available or Updates could not be checked, with the installed version, when the app last checked and Refresh. Below it, Available versions has, while a nightly build runs, a Nightly / Release switch, then the newest version of the chosen channel, which includes every earlier one, with Update to version N at its bottom right when it is newer. A nightly build also shows when it was built, its commit and its first three changes (Show all N changes shows the rest); an official release shows its version, status and release date. When the installed version is the newest, it is marked Running and the status box says This app is up to date. Update now downloads and verifies the package, backs up this installation, records your approval and installs it; the app restarts into the new version, which then awaits acceptance.

Update approvals lists every approval. Approve a package from outside the app records the approval of a package installed by hand: review its release notes, copy the published version and risk description, and choose a recent verified manual or pre-update backup (Request pre-update backup is inside that dialog).

sections.title: Good practice
paragraphs: Use the laboratory’s approved update procedure and release evidence. Available updates installs only a build newer than the running version whose package signature the app verified while downloading it; it does not check on a schedule. A package chosen in Record update approval is identified only by its SHA-256 and is installed outside the app. About this app identifies the currently running version for support.

Review the backup completion time, retained verified destinations and package identity before approval. Record the checks actually completed when accepting a version. An approval added after an unapproved start requires a later start under that approval before acceptance is available.

sections.title: If you cannot continue
paragraphs: For a warning about the already installed app, inspect the Running row on Installed versions and its status. For a missing backup choice during update approval, inspect Backups → Runs, refresh the backup list or load older runs. The list includes only qualifying retained manual or pre-update backups completed within the last 24 hours.

If Available updates says updates are not available in this build, install a published release once from the project’s release page. If a check, download or installation fails, read the message and correlation ID; the running version is unchanged and the downloaded package can be downloaded again.

The App version notice can be closed with Dismiss notification for the current signed-in view. Its health finding remains available through Health in the header and Versions and updates. Closing the notice records no approval or acceptance.

pages.title: Versions and updates
pages.purpose: Check and install newer published updates, review the detected running version and record its acceptance, or record approval and backup evidence before installing an update.
pages.access: Installed versions and Available updates are available to signed-in users with access to this page. Manage configuration downloads, approves and installs updates, opens Update approvals and records or withdraws approval. Backup and restore is also needed to read the backup choices and request backups in this UI. Approve configuration accepts the running version.

fields.name: Installed versions / Available updates / Update approvals tabs
fields.meaning: Switch between versions that have run, updates published for this app, and recorded approval decisions.
fields.values: Available updates (default); Installed versions; Update approvals.
fields.rules: Update approvals is shown with Manage configuration. Opening Available updates checks the published updates; tab selection changes no record.

fields.name: Version (installed records and detail panels)
fields.meaning: Identify the version already running, whether it is accepted, and versions recorded by earlier starts.
fields.values: Read-only version strings from application startup records. Running marks the current version; its status and, for an accepted version, who accepted it and when are in its row and details.
fields.rules: No version is typed for acceptance. Inspect the running record and its status before using Accept this version for clinical use. Earlier versions remain in the list.

fields.name: Version to install (Approve a package from outside the app)
fields.meaning: The published version of the downloaded update that will be installed.
fields.values: Copy the exact version from the update’s release notes: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, optionally followed by valid prerelease/build identifiers, such as 1.2.0 or 1.2.0-rc.1. Maximum 64 characters.
fields.rules: Required and initially blank; surrounding spaces are trimmed. Do not enter the currently running version unless that is the package actually being approved. The app does not extract or verify this version from the selected file. Obtain missing release information from the publisher.

fields.name: Update status (Available updates)
fields.meaning: Whether a newer build is published for this app, and which version is installed.
fields.values: This app is up to date; An update is available (a newer build in either channel); Updates could not be checked (a channel could not be read and no newer build was found). Installed version: N.
fields.rules: Read-only; read when the tab opens or on Refresh. The icon and words carry the status, not color alone. Up to date means no newer published build, not acceptance for clinical use; that is on Installed versions.

fields.name: Nightly / Release switch (Available updates)
fields.meaning: Choose which channel Available versions shows.
fields.values: Nightly; Release. Nightly is selected first while a nightly build runs.
fields.rules: Shown only while a nightly build runs; a release installation sees official releases only, without the switch. Choosing a side reads nothing new.

fields.name: Available versions (Available updates)
fields.meaning: The newest published version of the chosen channel. It includes every earlier one, so only it is offered.
fields.values: Version with Newer, Running or Older. A nightly build adds its built time, commit and the first three What’s new lines, with Show all N changes / Show fewer changes when there are more; its What’s new lists the changes since the previous nightly build only. An official release shows its version, status and release date.
fields.rules: Read-only; read when the tab opens or on Refresh. Only a newer version offers Update to version N, at its bottom right; when the installed version is the newest it is marked Running, with no Update.

fields.name: Status (Available updates)
fields.meaning: Whether a nightly build could replace the running version.
fields.values: Newer; Older; Running.
fields.rules: Read-only. Only Newer builds can be downloaded and installed; installing an older build is refused because a newer version may already have changed the database.

fields.name: Built / Commit / Changes (update details)
fields.meaning: When the build was published, the source commit of a nightly build, and its published change summary.
fields.values: Time in the laboratory time zone or Not given; the first 12 characters of the commit; up to 50 published change lines of at most 200 characters, or No change summary was published.
fields.rules: Read-only, as published by the project. The change lines are commit subjects since the previous build of that channel, not validation evidence.

fields.name: Update progress (Update to version N)
fields.meaning: The steps the app is running for this update.
fields.values: Download the package and check its signature; Back up this installation and verify the copy; Record your approval of this package; Install and restart. Each shows Done or In progress.
fields.rules: Read-only. A failed step stops the update, shows the reason and leaves the dialog open to try again; steps already done stay done (a downloaded package and an approval are reused).

fields.name: Changes / Risk class / Approval notes (Update to version N)
fields.meaning: The approval recorded with the update.
fields.values: Changes: I have reviewed the changes in this version (required). Risk class, as published: prefilled Not published (development build), up to 200 characters. Approval notes: prefilled Updated to N from Available updates., up to 500 characters.
fields.rules: Edit the prefilled text when the publisher gave a risk class or other checks were made. The version and package come from this update; the pre-update backup is taken by the app, so neither is chosen here.

fields.name: First started / Last started / Running
fields.meaning: Show when a version ran on this installation and whether it is the running version.
fields.values: Saved times and Yes/No.
fields.rules: Read-only; versions are recorded on startup.

fields.name: Status (Installed versions)
fields.meaning: Current approval/acceptance situation for a version.
fields.values: Accepted; Awaiting acceptance; Started without approval; Previous.
fields.rules: Read-only. Starting first and approving later does not retrospectively approve that start.

fields.name: Approved / Accepted for clinical use
fields.meaning: Attributable approval and acceptance decisions.
fields.values: Person and time, or None.
fields.rules: Read-only; these are distinct decisions.

fields.name: Risk class, as published
fields.meaning: Release risk description supplied with the software release.
fields.values: Published text up to 200 characters.
fields.rules: Required and initially blank; surrounding spaces are trimmed. Copy the release publisher’s description. If absent, obtain it from the publisher rather than inventing a risk class.

fields.name: Release notes
fields.meaning: Attest that the release documentation was reviewed.
fields.values: I have reviewed the release notes for this version.
fields.rules: Required checkbox; initially unchecked.

fields.name: Backup before this update (Approve a package from outside the app)
fields.meaning: Choose a verified backup to retain as recovery evidence for the planned update.
fields.values: Initially blank. Choices come from this installation’s Backups → Runs history, starting with the newest 100 runs. Eligible choices show completion time and retained verified destinations. Up to 15 choices use a selector; larger lists use a searchable picker.
fields.rules: Required. The engine includes only successful Manual or Before an update runs with at least one verified copy not recorded as pruned, finished no more than 24 hours ago and not dated in the future. Scheduled runs, queued/failed/interrupted runs, old runs and runs with no retained verified copy are excluded. The engine rechecks eligibility when approval is saved.

fields.name: Approval notes
fields.meaning: Record the review and agreement supporting update approval.
fields.values: Explanation up to 500 characters.
fields.rules: Required; retained with the audit evidence.

fields.name: Package file / Package SHA-256
fields.meaning: Identify the exact package selected for approval.
fields.values: Native file selection in Record update approval, or the package downloaded by Update to version N; then saved filename and computed fingerprint.
fields.rules: In Record update approval the native chooser opens after confirmation; canceling it records no approval and keeps the form open. The saved filename and computed SHA-256 are read-only evidence of the selected bytes. For a chosen file they do not establish the package version or publisher signature; a downloaded package’s signature was verified by the app.

fields.name: Your password
fields.meaning: Reconfirm the person making approval or clinical acceptance.
fields.values: Your current password.
fields.rules: Required for approval or acceptance when using password sign-in. Initially blank and checked again for each decision. Security-key accounts instead receive the Security key control.

fields.name: Note (Accept version)
fields.meaning: Describe the checks supporting laboratory acceptance of the running software.
fields.values: Specific explanation up to 500 characters.
fields.rules: Required; recording acceptance does not perform those checks.

fields.name: Status / Withdrawn (Update approvals)
fields.meaning: Show whether a recorded approval remains usable.
fields.values: Not yet installed; Installed; Withdrawn, with withdrawal person/time where present.
fields.rules: Read-only. Approval can be withdrawn only before that version starts under the approval.

fields.name: Reason (Withdraw approval)
fields.meaning: Explain why a pending approval is withdrawn.
fields.values: Explanation up to 500 characters.
fields.rules: Required; the withdrawn approval remains on record.

fields.name: Pre-update backup run (approval details)
fields.meaning: Identify the backup run retained with an existing approval.
fields.values: Read-only run identifier, also shown with the installed version when it has approval evidence.
fields.rules: This is historical evidence. It is distinct from the Backup before this update selector used while creating approval.

fields.name: Security key / Security key PIN
fields.meaning: Confirm approval or acceptance using the registered key for a security-key account.
fields.values: Security key lists your active registered keys and initially uses your current selection or the first available key. Enter that key’s PIN only if prompted, or complete the key’s supported biometric verification.
fields.rules: Conditional on security-key sign-in. Selecting a key does not confirm the decision; complete the prompted verification when submitting. No active registered key requires sign-in recovery. The key PIN is different from the LIS password.

fields.name: App version notice
fields.meaning: Draw attention to a running version awaiting acceptance or started without approval.
fields.values: The engine’s current warning or alert and a Versions and updates link.
fields.rules: Displayed across signed-in screens while the finding applies, unless dismissed in the current signed-in view. The status remains in Host health and the version records after dismissal.

actions.name: Request pre-update backup
actions.does: Queue a new backup marked Before an update without leaving the approval form.
actions.availableWhen: Backup and restore authority; inside Approve a package from outside the app.
actions.result: A backup request is saved independently of approval. Wait for a verified retained copy in Backups → Runs, refresh the backup list if needed, and explicitly select it. Requesting a backup does not select it or approve an update; canceling the approval form does not cancel the saved backup request.

actions.name: Refresh (Available updates)
actions.does: Read the published official release and nightly builds again.
actions.availableWhen: Available updates, in a build that can install updates.
actions.result: The icon turns while the check runs; the time next to it shows when the builds were last read. Nothing is downloaded or recorded. The app checks only when the tab opens or on Refresh, never on a schedule.

actions.name: Update to version N
actions.does: Open the update dialog for a newer build.
actions.availableWhen: Manage configuration; the build is newer than the running version; this build can install updates. Shown under Official release or in a newer nightly build’s details.
actions.result: Opens Update to version N. Nothing is downloaded or recorded until Update now.

actions.name: Update now
actions.does: Download and verify the package, take and verify a pre-update backup, record the approval of that package and install it.
actions.availableWhen: Backup and restore authority and an available backup folder (the dialog offers Add backup folder when there is none); the Changes confirmation and fresh identity confirmation.
actions.result: The app checks that no listener or other work is in progress, that the approval names exactly this package and that its backup is verified, audits the installation, then closes and starts the new version, which awaits acceptance. An earlier approval of the same package is reused without a second backup. A package already downloaded is checked again rather than downloaded twice. A failed step leaves the running version unchanged.

actions.name: Add backup folder (Update to version N)
actions.does: Add the backup target the update needs, without leaving the dialog.
actions.availableWhen: Backup and restore authority and no available backup folder.
actions.result: Opens Add backup target; after the folder is chosen the dialog can continue. Choose Backups and audit anchors as Receives.

actions.name: Approve a package from outside the app / Choose the update package
actions.does: Open the approval form, then select the downloaded package in the native chooser and record its SHA-256 with the review evidence.
actions.availableWhen: Manage configuration, access to the backup choices, required version/risk/review/note fields, a qualifying backup and fresh identity confirmation. A current nonwithdrawn approval for the same version prevents another. Shown on Update approvals.
actions.result: Creates approval evidence and updates Update approvals. The selected package is not installed by this action. Canceling the chooser saves no approval and leaves entered fields available to correct or retry.

actions.name: Accept this version for clinical use / Accept version
actions.does: Open acceptance for the automatically identified running version and record the laboratory’s completed checks.
actions.availableWhen: Approve configuration; the running version is Awaiting acceptance, is the first installed version or has started under a current approval, and is not already accepted. A note and fresh identity confirmation are required.
actions.result: The version becomes Accepted in this installation’s records. Acceptance needs no typed version, selected package or backup run. The action records the decision; it does not perform the laboratory’s checks.

actions.name: Withdraw approval
actions.does: Remove permission to use a pending approval.
actions.availableWhen: Manage configuration, approval not withdrawn or installed, current revision and reason.
actions.result: Retains the approval as Withdrawn; installation without another approval raises an alert.

actions.name: Open row / Previous / Next / Close
actions.does: Inspect version, nightly build or approval details.
actions.result: Shows recorded package, backup and decision evidence, or a published build’s changes, without changing them.

actions.name: Load older backup runs
actions.does: Read the next page of backup history and add its eligible choices to the approval form.
actions.availableWhen: More history is available in Record update approval; disabled while another backup read is in progress.
actions.result: Adds eligible runs without changing the chosen run. No new backup or approval is created.

actions.name: Refresh backup list / Try again
actions.does: Read the loaded backup history again, including current verification and eligibility.
actions.availableWhen: Refresh backup list is in Record update approval; Try again appears with a failed backup read except an authorization refusal.
actions.result: Updated eligible choices replace the previous read. Pending loaded backup jobs also refresh every five seconds while reads succeed; a failed read stops automatic polling until retried.

actions.name: Backups → Runs
actions.does: Open the recorded backup history to investigate completion and copy outcomes.
actions.availableWhen: Shown in the approval form and after requesting a pre-update backup; the destination requires Backup and restore authority.
actions.result: Navigates away from the approval form. Unsubmitted approval fields are not saved; complete the backup investigation before reopening the form.

actions.name: Cancel / Escape (approval, acceptance or withdrawal)
actions.does: Close the current decision dialog before submitting.
actions.availableWhen: The decision is not currently being recorded.
actions.result: Discards unsaved dialog fields without creating or withdrawing approval or recording acceptance. A backup already requested from the dialog remains queued or completed.

actions.name: Continue / Cancel (security-key verification)
actions.does: Submit a requested key PIN or cancel the current verification.
actions.availableWhen: A security-key confirmation is active; Continue appears when the key requests its PIN.
actions.result: Successful verification allows the submitted decision to continue through engine checks. Cancel stops verification; if Windows has its own security dialog, finish or cancel that dialog as well.

actions.name: Dismiss notification (App version notice)
actions.does: Hide the app-wide version notice while retaining its health finding and version records.
actions.availableWhen: The running version has a visible warning or alert notice.
actions.result: Dismissal lasts across page navigation and repeated reads of the same warning. The notice returns when the running version or warning changes, after a resolved warning recurs, or when the signed-in view is recreated, such as after locking/unlocking, signing in again or restarting. It records no approval or acceptance and changes no engine gate.

restrictions: Available updates installs only newer builds published by the project, after verifying the package signature, recording an approval with a verified backup and confirming that no work is in progress. A package chosen in Record update approval is identified only by its SHA-256, is not installed by the app and its version and signature are not verified.
Human laboratory acceptance is not established by software tests or by an agent’s completion statement.
An approval recorded after an unapproved start requires a subsequent restart under that approval before acceptance can proceed.
Scheduled backups are excluded from update approval because automatic retention can remove them. Manual and pre-update backups are retained by the current automatic retention policy.
Dismissing the App version notice is a temporary display choice. Approval, acceptance, health findings and clinical gates retain their actual state.

Builds compiled without the project’s update key, such as local developer builds and releases published before in-app updates, cannot download or install updates; install a newer release by hand once.
Nightly builds are offered only to nightly builds and are for testing with synthetic data. An official release is offered to every build with a lower version.
The published update list is not itself signed or dated; the package signature binds each package to its version, and only newer versions install.
workflow: For the app already installed, inspect the Running row on Installed versions. Complete the laboratory’s checks, choose Accept this version for clinical use in its row menu or details when available, enter a specific note and confirm your identity. Verify the Accepted status.
For an update published for this app, open Available updates and review the newer build’s changes. Choose Update to version N; add a backup folder if the dialog asks for one.
Confirm that you reviewed the changes, adjust the risk class or notes if needed, confirm your identity and choose Update now. Let the app back up, approve, install and restart.
For a package obtained outside the app, review its release notes and published risk. Inspect a recent verified manual or pre-update backup, or request one and wait for verification.
For a downloaded update, review its release notes and published risk. Inspect a recent verified manual or pre-update backup, or request one and wait for verification.

On Update approvals, choose Approve a package from outside the app, copy Version to install and the published risk description, confirm release-note review, select Backup before this update, and enter Approval notes.
Confirm your identity, choose the exact downloaded package and verify the saved approval. Perform installation through the laboratory’s approved process outside this screen.
After the new version starts, complete the laboratory’s acceptance checks and accept the detected running version.

troubleshooting.problem: I do not know which version to enter
troubleshooting.recovery: For acceptance of the installed app, use Accept this version for clinical use; the app supplies its version. Version to install belongs to a future update approval: copy it from that download’s release notes. If the release does not supply version or risk information, obtain it from the publisher before approving.

troubleshooting.problem: A completed backup is not listed
troubleshooting.recovery: The list comes from this installation’s Backups → Runs history. Refresh backup list and, when available, Load older backup runs. Check that the run is Manual or Before an update, successfully finished within the last 24 hours, and has a verified copy not recorded as pruned. Scheduled backups do not qualify. Request a new pre-update backup if no retained run qualifies.

troubleshooting.problem: The backup list cannot be read
troubleshooting.recovery: Read the error and correlation ID. Backup and restore authority is required to load the choices; Manage configuration alone does not grant it. Resolve the permission or read failure, then use Try again or Refresh backup list.

troubleshooting.problem: Backup is too old or no longer eligible at approval
troubleshooting.recovery: The engine checks the backup again when saving, even if it was offered earlier. Refresh the list and select a qualifying recent run, or request and verify a new pre-update backup.

The running-version box explains it. Review the incident, record an approval of this version on Update approvals (Approve a package from outside the app) if appropriate and restart under it before acceptance. Adding approval or dismissing the notice does not erase the unapproved start.

troubleshooting.problem: Approval already exists or withdrawal was refused
troubleshooting.recovery: Reload Update approvals and inspect the current record. A current approval prevents a duplicate. Only a nonwithdrawn approval whose version has not started under it can be withdrawn; use its current revision.

troubleshooting.problem: No package was chosen or the package could not be read
troubleshooting.recovery: No approval is recorded when file selection is canceled. Keep or correct the entered review information and choose the intended readable package again. Inspect any error and correlation ID before retrying.

Check Approve configuration authority, the Running marker and the current status. An already accepted or previous version cannot be accepted again through this action. A later version must have started under its current approval. Refresh after another person changes the record and review any authentication error before retrying.

troubleshooting.problem: The version notice returned after dismissal
troubleshooting.recovery: A changed version or warning, a recurring warning, or a recreated signed-in view shows the notice again. Inspect Versions and updates or Host health to address the finding; dismissing it only hides the notice.

troubleshooting.problem: Updates are not available in this build
troubleshooting.recovery: This build was compiled without the project’s update key, for example a local developer build or a release published before in-app updates. Install a newer published release from the project’s release page once; later releases can then be installed from Available updates.

troubleshooting.problem: The update server could not be reached
troubleshooting.recovery: Check this computer’s internet connection and any proxy, then choose Refresh, or Update to version N again. The running version and laboratory work are unaffected.

troubleshooting.problem: The update package failed its signature check
troubleshooting.recovery: The package was not kept and nothing was installed. Do not install the package by other means; report the version and correlation ID to the project.

troubleshooting.problem: Wait until these finish, then install
troubleshooting.recovery: Listeners or other work are still in progress. Let them finish or stop them as the laboratory’s procedure allows, then choose the install action again.

troubleshooting.problem: The downloaded package differs from the approved one
troubleshooting.recovery: A current approval names another package of the same version. Withdraw it on Update approvals, then choose Update to version N again.

troubleshooting.problem: The update could not be installed
troubleshooting.recovery: The running version is unchanged and a failed installation is recorded in the audit trail. Read the correlation ID, check free disk space and, on Linux, the administrator password prompt or the AppImage’s file permissions, then try again.

troubleshooting.problem: Choose where backups are saved, or Your account cannot start backups
troubleshooting.recovery: An update needs a verified backup first. Add a backup folder from the dialog (Backup and restore authority), or ask someone with that authority to update.

troubleshooting.problem: The backup failed or finished without a verified copy
troubleshooting.recovery: Check the backup folder in System → Backups (available, enough space, writable), then choose Update now again.
